title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic Claude API 'message threads' (public beta) cut time-to-first-token ~35% on long Claude Code requests
bullets.summary: Later requests send only new messages while the server keeps the conversation, giving about 35% lower median time to first token for Claude Code requests at 500K-1M tokens; threads expire after 5 idle minutes (release notes anchor is Nov 2, picked up in the Nov 6 brief).
bullets.how: The Construct: long-running agent sessions get faster and cheaper to drive with no prompt changes; test on the Mac runner and scheduled routines. PRAGMA: concrete latency/cost talking point for client agent builds. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash goes GA: 15-second clips, 720p at $0.07/second (-30%)
bullets.summary: Google's video model now generates clips up to 15s (vs 10s in Omni 1.1) with 720p output pricing down 30% to $0.07 per second.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: cheap short video for signage install/before-after social clips and ad creative. The Construct: a low-cost video-gen option next to the Higgsfield MCP; benchmark quality and cost before routing work to it.

bullets.title: arXiv 2611.07372 'EnvOpt': reorganizing the environment cut agent task cost 72.7% with a higher pass rate
bullets.summary: With model and harness fixed, restructuring the environment cut Claude Haiku 4.5 cost on AutomationBench by 72.7% and raised the pass rate.
bullets.how: The Construct: points at tool/context layout (how files, skills and MCP outputs are presented) as a bigger cost lever than model choice; audit our routine environments. PRAGMA: a method to sell as an agent-efficiency tune-up.

bullets.title: METR assesses Anthropic's AI R&D acceleration at roughly 2x the prior pace
bullets.summary: METR says capability improvement on well-specified tasks is running about 2x its March 2024-October 2025 pace (1.3x-3x would not surprise it), though Anthropic redacted most of the most informative evidence.
bullets.how: The Construct: expect faster model turnover, so keep skills and routines model-agnostic and re-test after each release. PRAGMA: useful framing for client roadmaps. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber: gated release, 48.5% on ExploitGym (vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber)
bullets.summary: Access is restricted through Daybreak Red with identity checks and organizational security requirements; system card published.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: supports an agent-endpoint hardening audit offer as offensive capability keeps rising. The Construct: keep the Mac runner patched and credentials scoped. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Cost and speed now come from the layer around the model: server-side conversation state, a reorganized environment (-72.7% cost in EnvOpt) and cheaper video pricing all beat swapping models, so tune context and environment first and keep workflows portable as model cadence accelerates. (Caveats: items come from a secondary daily brief, primary links not individually opened; no verified signage, CRM or DAM MCP news and no DeepSeek/Mistral/xAI/Meta launches found, so those categories are omitted.)
